description: Land Acquisition - Munamalegama, Maha D/S Division, Kurunegala District
categorisation: This gazette content is exclusively about land acquisition matters under the Land Acquisition Act. It contains detailed notices for acquiring specific land parcels and servitudes for infrastructure development (construction of an over fly across the Maho railway line), including comprehensive descriptions of multiple land lots with their names, uses, claimed ownership status, and exact measurements. This fits perfectly within the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) which covers land acquisitions, transfers, and property-related administrative matters.
